== Biography ==
Margaret was born in 1766. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3403|John Glasgow]] and [[Mill-757|Margaret Mill]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-3314]] is assessed at 82% (probable). The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index entry for Margaret Glasgow, 28 September 1766 at West Calder (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/3142391), reads the parent fields that the previous review could not see: father John and mother Margaret (forenames only). It belongs to the John Glasgow and Margaret Mill household of West Calder attached as John [[Glasgow-3314]], whose Agnes of 1770 is transcribed with the full couple. Confidence rises to 82%.

The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms rows are Ancestry's copy of the FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms index already cited, so they verify the indexed parent fields rather than adding an independent source; the original register is uninspected. The row gives the mother's forename only. John-3314's identification with the 1740 Irvine child still needs a bridge and is not addressed here. No mother change follows.
